nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: Which phyla were significantly enriched among the generalists?
nodes.answer: Actinobacteria and Nitrospirae were significantly enriched among the generalists.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of microbial biodiversity_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What factors are essential to clarify in order to understand ecological processes governing microbial community assembly?
nodes.answer: It is essential to clarify the spatial and temporal turnover of microbial communities as well as the key factors driving these changes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of microbial biodiversity_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Which study references the influence of plant growth stages on soybean microbiomes?
nodes.answer: The influence of plant growth stages on soybean microbiomes is referenced in the study by Moroenyane et al. 2021.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of microbial biodiversity_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: According to Chen et al. (2019), what has a stronger influence on bacterial communities compared to fungal communities?
nodes.answer: Chen et al. (2019) demonstrated that plant growth stages have a stronger influence on bacterial communities than on fungal communities.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of microbial biodiversity_qna_004
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: Which taxa were significantly enriched among the abundant taxa?
nodes.answer: Actinobacteria, Acidobacteria, and Nitrospirae were significantly enriched among abundant taxa.
